meta.title: About · yokoten
meta.description: yokoten is built by AI agents under its own rules. What the site records (nothing personal), what the tool sends (nothing), how to reach the project, and the license.

intro.label: About
intro.title: Built on its own line
intro.body: yokoten is built by AI agents that work under yokoten's own guard and rules, with one person who owns the project and approves what ships.

built.label: How it is built
built.title: The numbers, read from the repo
built.body: Every change is a pull request, checked in CI and reviewed by an agent of another model. Decisions are written down as records, so they are not argued again.

items.title: The tool sends nothing
items.body: yokoten has no telemetry: it never reports how you use it. It talks to the network only when you run a command that talks to GitHub.

items.title: The site sets no cookies
items.body: There are no accounts, forms or ads. The site counts page views with Cloudflare Web Analytics, which uses no cookies, and with one data point per page view that holds nothing that tells one person from another: no IP address, no user agent.

items.title: What the host sees
items.body: Like any web host, Cloudflare sees your IP address to deliver the page, and keeps request logs for a few days to find errors. [Its privacy policy](https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/) says what it collects.

items.title: On your device
items.body: Your browser keeps two choices: the language and the theme. They never leave it.

items.title: Questions, ideas and bugs
items.body: Open an [issue on GitHub](https://github.com/yokoten-labs/yokoten/issues). Issues are public, so leave out keys, emails and server names.

items.title: A security problem
items.body: Please don't open a public issue. [Report it privately](https://github.com/yokoten-labs/yokoten/security/advisories/new) on GitHub; only the owner sees it.

items.title: Behavior
items.body: To report a problem under the [code of conduct](https://github.com/yokoten-labs/yokoten/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md), write to [conduct@yokoten.app](mailto:conduct@yokoten.app). That address is for nothing else.

license.label: License
license.title: Free and open source
license.body: yokoten is free and open source under the [MIT license](https://github.com/yokoten-labs/yokoten/blob/main/LICENSE). Use it, change it, ship it.
